title: Completed-item alternatives across comparable holders and builds

cases.title: Aphelios without Rageblade
cases.subject: items
cases.original_question: How do Kraken's Fury and Guinsoo's Rageblade builds compare on Aphelios? Are there good builds without Rageblade?
cases.question: How do Kraken's Fury and Guinsoo's Rageblade builds compare on Aphelios? Are there good builds without Rageblade?
cases.scenario: Two-star Aphelios with exactly three ordinary completed items. Discover actual remaining pairs before comparing Kraken-only, Rageblade-only and both-item packages; do not fix an unsupported pair.
cases.plan: Resolve Aphelios and both items. Use rank_unit_loadouts for two-star, three-item build discovery, paginating supported triplets. Select ordinary triplets through the local item catalogue and resolved identities. Use compare_cohorts on explicit holder-bound triplets within shared observed companion/frontline conditions and final levels. Enforce one Aphelios copy for joint item predicates. Use query_cohort for board item-count and support composition diagnostics.
cases.checks: Report triplet boards, loadout_pick_rate with its holder denominator, mean placement, top4 and win rates. Compare the same other-item pair when one has public support in both arms. Keep both-items separate, preserve overlap/suppression/interval warnings, and do not substitute item marginals. Without a common pair, give descriptive whole-build results and say the one-slot contrast is unresolved.
cases.limits: Exact global item budget, all ordinary equipment on the entire board and automatic matching are unavailable; ordinary here refers to the selected Aphelios triplet. Declare residual companion investment differences. Historical 901-game web evidence supplies no current gold value.

cases.title: Brambleback's third fighter item
cases.subject: items
cases.original_question: With Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge on Brambleback, how does Titan's Resolve compare with Edge of Night for the last slot?
cases.question: With Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge on Brambleback, how does Titan's Resolve compare with Edge of Night for the last slot?
cases.scenario: Two-star Brambleback with Bloodthirster and Infinity Edge, plus exactly Titan's Resolve or Edge of Night; three ordinary completed items on a single holder.
cases.plan: Resolve the holder and all four item names. rank_unit_loadouts with the fixed pair, three items and exact star discovers whether the named triplets are reportable. compare_cohorts uses the exact two alternatives, one-holder-copy guard and common final-level/core conditions. Query frontline and carry loadouts to describe remaining investment.
cases.checks: Preserve the fixed pair even if rare. Compare boards, histogram, mean/top4/win and returned effect intervals; distinguish a missing ranking row from an explicitly empty cohort. Reject use of the old 4.11 versus 4.21 item marginals as the fixed-build difference. No cast-time or stack-speed conclusion from placement.
cases.limits: Post-September-24/28 interpretation requires verified execution-scope provenance; no date/subpatch call filter exists. Exact whole-board matching is limited to named supported conditions and descriptive item-count groups.
